reason: Paylocity sells HCM/payroll/HR software with payroll tax filing to US mid-sized employers. RingCentral sells cloud communications (phone, video, contact center, AI voice agents). Both are subscription SaaS sold to businesses, but the products serve different functions and do not overlap.
reason_if_0: Different industry: HR/payroll software versus cloud communications and contact center software. The only shared traits are generic cloud, platform and subscription wording and a broad business customer base.
